# Batch Print Kit

Batch Print Kit is an open-source Windows batch printing tool.

Main site: https://lihongyu5432-ux.github.io/BatchPrintKit/

Chinese landing page: https://lihongyu5432-ux.github.io/BatchPrintKit/zh-CN.html

GitHub repository: https://github.com/lihongyu5432-ux/BatchPrintKit

Latest release: https://github.com/lihongyu5432-ux/BatchPrintKit/releases/latest

## Summary

Batch Print Kit helps Windows users collect files and folders into a reviewable print queue before printing. It is useful for offices, warehouses, stores, schools, and anyone printing folders of PDFs, Office documents, labels, order files, or images.

## Core features

- Tkinter desktop UI
- Windows Explorer integration
- Multi-file import and folder scanning
- Queue review before printing
- Printer selection
- Opens the selected printer driver's own settings page
- Optional SumatraPDF backend for PDF printing
- CLI with dry-run behavior
- MIT license

## Important caveat

PDF printing can use SumatraPDF when installed. Office formats still depend on the Windows registered application and printer driver.
